_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.src: The report suggests that the two species would compete for space.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.dst: В докладе сказано, что два народа будут бороться за территорию.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.src: "Public opinion is firmly against removal of the natives..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.src: Find out what's happening at the theatre.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.src: Interesting to see a Human wanting to see a Dwarven play!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.dst: Надо же, человек хочет посмотреть пьесу дворфов!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.src: The only play we're performing is the annual Victory Festival.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.dst: Сейчас идёт только ежегодный Праздник Победы.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.src: The entry cost is [{~} Emerald Block]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.src: Just take a seat and enjoy the show.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.src: Wait, is that- Hey, {u}! It's so good to see you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.dst: Постой, это же- Эй, {u}! Как я рад тебя видеть!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.src: Hello, to the people of Gavel, glad to see so many here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.dst: Приветствую, жители Gavel, рад видеть столько гостей!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.dst: Надеюсь, пьеса вам понравится и будет очень поучительной. Сегодня я ваш рассказчик.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play, and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.dst: Надеюсь, пьеса вам понравится и будет очень поучительной. Сегодня я ваш рассказчик.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.src: Pheeeew. I think we outran the villagers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.src: I think we are safe here in the mountains. Oh look. Shiny ores. This is like a gold mine.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.dst: Думаю, в горах мы в безопасности. О, смотри. Блестящая руда. Прямо золотая жила.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.src: These nice minerals are very nice, let us start digging.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.dst: Эти славные минералы очень славные, давайте копать.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.src: I am a dangerous monster and I will not let you mine these diamonds. We are the Doguns, and we will kill you!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.dst: Я опасное чудище и не дам вам добывать эти алмазы. Мы Dogun, и мы вас убьём!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.src: Graoaoro. I will eat you all for my afternoon demon luncheon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.dst: Граоаоро. Я съем вас всех на свой демонический полдник.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.src: MOAHAHAHA. WE WILL KILL ALL OF YOU.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.src: We need to forge better weapons so we can fight back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.dst: Надо выковать оружие получше, чтобы дать отпор.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.src: Good idea! We will use our intelligence to slay the demons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.dst: Отличная мысль! Мы сразим демонов своим умом.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.src: YOU CANNOT BEAT US, WE CAN SUMMON DRAGONS WITH OUR MAGIC.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.dst: ВАМ НАС НЕ ПОБЕДИТЬ, НАША МАГИЯ ПРИЗЫВАЕТ ДРАКОНОВ.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.src: Dragons are no match for us?? CHARGE!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.dst: Драконы нам не ровня?? В АТАКУ!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.src: We have won. Hooray. And now we have established a great citadel, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.dst: Мы победили. Ура. И теперь у нас великая цитадель, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.src: The dwarven intellect beat the sheer power of the demons magic.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.dst: Ум дворфов одолел грубую силу демонской магии.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.src: I hope you enjoyed the show, and learned something new today!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.dst: Надеюсь, вам понравилось и вы узнали что-то новое!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.src: We are continuing the celebration at the old Demon City. Follow the red banners outside {p} to get there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.dst: Праздник продолжится в старом Городе Демонов. Идите за красными флагами от {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.src: Ugh, that was awful. Don't believe anything you see here, human. History is written by the victors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.dst: Фу, какой ужас. Не верь ничему, что тут видишь, человек. Историю пишут победители.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.src: Make your way to the Dogun Festival by following the red banners outside {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.dst: Доберись до праздника Dogun, следуя за красными флагами за пределами {p}.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.src: Welcome one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.dst: Добро пожаловать, все! Братья и сёстры дворфы, гости!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.src: Welcome, one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.dst: Добро пожаловать, все-все! Братья и сёстры дворфы, гости и приезжие!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.src: Axelus! You are under arrest for high treason!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.dst: Axelus! Ты арестован за государственную измену!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.src: The cover crumbles a touch at your grip when you open it up. How old is this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.dst: Обложка слегка крошится в руках, когда открываешь. Сколько же ей лет?

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.src: If I could draw your attention to the wooden stage in the north, we can begin.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.dst: Прошу внимания к деревянной сцене на севере, начинаем.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.src: Welcome to the annual festival where we celebrate victory over the foul demons...The Doguns!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.dst: Добро пожаловать на ежегодный праздник победы над мерзкими демонами… Dogun!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.src: Now, if I can get you to turn around to face the bonfire, we've prepared a lovely firecasting show for you all while we prepare!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.dst: А теперь повернитесь к костру: пока мы готовимся, вас ждёт чудесное огненное шоу!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.src: Wow, I didn't know Dwarves could learn such magic! Beats the heck out of firecrackers!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.dst: Ух ты, не знал, что дворфы владеют такой магией! Куда лучше хлопушек!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.speaker: Mahou

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.src: Magnificent! Thank you very much to our fire casters. Now, ladies and gents, your attention to the main stage please!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.dst: Великолепно! Спасибо нашим огненным магам. А теперь, дамы и господа, внимание на сцену!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.src: For the last {~} years we have captured renegade Doguns that escaped the war, and this year is no exception!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.dst: Уже {~} лет мы ловим беглых Dogun, уцелевших в войне, и этот год не исключение!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.src: We shall now entomb the foul demon to join the ranks of the other Doguns on display.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.dst: Сейчас мы замуруем мерзкого демона к прочим выставленным Dogun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.src: Note its magical might, its aggressive nature, its intense heat, and its fierce appearance.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.dst: Взгляните на его магическую мощь, агрессивный нрав, сильный жар и свирепый облик.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.src: All no match for the ingenuity and comeradery of the Dwarven nations!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.dst: Всё это ничто перед смекалкой и братством дворфов!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.src: M-Monsters... You all...are the demons here...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.speaker: Dogun

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.src: Every year, every year, every single YEAR you do this. You all need to open your god-blessed eyes for once!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.dst: Каждый год, каждый год, каждый ГОД вы это делаете. Откройте же наконец глаза!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.src: Do you all really believe everything they tell you? Do you all just lap it up like dogs?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.dst: Вы правда верите всему, что вам говорят? Лакаете всё, как собаки?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.src: Our side won the war, but does that really mean we were in the right? I'll tell you right now, it doesn't!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.dst: Наша сторона выиграла войну, но значит ли это, что мы были правы? Скажу прямо: нет!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.src: We all see it- The Doguns have feelings, family and thoughts, just like anyone else here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.dst: Мы все это видим: у Dogun есть чувства, семьи и мысли, как у любого из нас!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.src: You are encasing live Doguns for entertainment. Public execution! This twisted display is more demonic than they ever could dream to be!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.dst: Вы замуровываете живых Dogun ради забавы. Публичная казнь! Это зрелище демоничнее всего, что они могли бы сделать!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.src: Guards! Get this propaganda spewing half pint to the Molten Core Prison, north side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.dst: Стража! Уведите этого крикуна-коротышку в Molten Core Prison, на северной стороне.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.src: Come along, sir. Let's not make more of a scene.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.dst: Пройдёмте, сударь. Не будем устраивать сцен.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.speaker: Dwarven Guard

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.src: Why would Axelus say something so blatantly wrong?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.dst: Зачем Axelus говорит такую откровенную чушь?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.src: What was he talking about? That was all nonsense!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.dst: О чём он вообще? Сплошной бред!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.src: Are they really taking him to the Molten Core? You've heard the horror stories about there, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.dst: Его правда ведут в Molten Core? Слышал же страшные истории о том месте?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.src: Well, the expression 'no hope blows from the north' came from there, since it's on the north side...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.dst: Ну да, поговорка «с севера надежда не дует» оттуда и пошла, раз оно на севере…
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.src: Apologies, all. I shall provide us all with a quick way back to {p} on the floor here. We hope you enjoyed the show, despite the interruption!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.dst: Прошу прощения у всех. Здесь, на полу, я открою быстрый путь обратно в {p}. Надеемся, шоу вам понравилось, несмотря на заминку!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.src: Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.dst: Узнай больше об истеричном дворфе в тюрьме {p}.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.src: I see I got your attention. Interested in the truth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.dst: Вижу, я привлёк твоё внимание. Интересуешься правдой.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.src: I'm no conspiracy nut. The Dwarves have been lied to for hundreds of years about the war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.dst: Я не помешан на заговорах. Сотни лет дворфам лгут о той войне.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.src: I have seen the truth. But my word isn't enough, is it? Seeing is believing, after all.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.dst: Я видел правду. Но моего слова мало, верно? Лучше один раз увидеть.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.src: Hopefully I will see you soon, {u}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.src: Pick up Axelus' note and head to the location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.dst: Возьми записку Axelus и отправляйся на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.src: Well, now you have read what I read. The truth...or the lie.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.dst: Ну вот, теперь и тебе известно то, что читал я. Правду… или ложь.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.src: My people are tyrants and conquerors...but they are also good. The people have been brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.dst: Мой народ - тираны и завоеватели… но и добрые тоже. Им промыли мозги.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.src: Many things are about to happen. If you want to know more, come to house number {~} in {p}. I'll be waiting.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.dst: Скоро многое случится. Хочешь узнать больше - приходи в дом номер {~} в {p}. Буду ждать.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.src: Search for house {~} in {p} like Axelus said.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.dst: Найди дом {~} в {p}, как сказал Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.src: Talk to Axelus in the Coalition Base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.dst: Поговори с Axelus на базе Коалиции.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.src: Ah, you made it. Come and meet Korzim
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.src: We...are those who...want peace. I am son...of the Dogun Chief... I have...been banished.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.dst: Мы… те, кто… хочет мира. Я сын… вождя Dogun… Я… изгнан.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.src: The coalition is a small group of believers in the truth. The Doguns aren't demons, and the Dwarves aren't all brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.dst: Коалиция - небольшая группа тех, кто верит в правду. Dogun не демоны, а дворфы не все одурманены.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won’t tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.dst: Но жить приходится тайно. Dogun не терпят дворфов, а дворфы ловят предателей и «демонов».
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won't tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.dst: Но, конечно, нам приходится прятаться. Dogun не терпят дворфов, а дворфы охотятся на предателей и «демонов».
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084.src: We would...melt the beds...they sleep in... After all...we are...molten rock.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084.dst: Мы бы… расплавили… их постели… Ведь мы… жидкий камень.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.src: This hideout was created by the Doguns in minutes, when it would have taken us days!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.dst: Это убежище Dogun сделали за минуты, а у нас ушли бы дни!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.src: It's a control panel. It's futile to figure out how it works, perhaps brute force is necessary.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.dst: Это пульт управления. Разбираться в нём бесполезно - возможно, нужна грубая сила.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.src: Right now, we're trying to convince the public. But it's proving difficult, if not impossible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.dst: Сейчас мы пытаемся убедить народ. Но это трудно, если не невозможно.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.src: It isn't {~} years ago. We have the technology and supply chains to live here peacefully, but they just won't listen!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.dst: Сейчас не {~} лет назад. У нас есть технологии и снабжение, чтобы жить здесь мирно, но они и слушать не хотят!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.src: We have...a plan... To win over...my people...that is.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.dst: У нас… есть план… Как склонить… мой народ… на нашу сторону.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.src: Korzim has told us that dragon bone is sacred to his people. We had to make some connections, but we have a way to get it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.dst: Korzim говорит, что драконья кость священна для его народа. Пришлось поискать связи, но теперь мы можем её достать.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.src: If you want, you could come with us. We can explain more of the situation later. Exit's through the back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.dst: Если хочешь, идём с нами. Подробности объясним позже. Выход сзади.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#092.src: Follow the group on the mission.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.src: The others...are just up ahead. I'll let you through...our tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.dst: Остальные… впереди. Я пропущу тебя… через наш туннель.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.src: We use.. earth and.. fire.. elements. It is slow... like us.. but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.dst: Мы используем… стихии земли… и огня. Это медленно… как мы… но мощно.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.src: We use...earth and...fire...elements. It is slow...like us...but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.dst: Мы используем… стихии земли… и огня. Это медленно… как мы… но мощно.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097.src: We don't forbid...you humans to be here, but please leave... We don't want any...unwanted dwarves here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097.dst: Мы не запрещаем… вам, людям, быть здесь, но уходите… Нам не нужны… незваные дворфы.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.src: We got this drill all the way from Corkus. Axelus had to pay a king's ransom to buy it, but this ought to work!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.dst: Этот бур мы привезли аж из Corkus. Axelus отдал за него целое состояние, но он должен сработать!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.src: AAAAGH! Idiot Corkus swindlers! Damn it all! How many emeralds did we waste?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.dst: Аргх! Проклятые жулики Corkus! Сколько изумрудов впустую?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.src: Ugh, do you have any experience with machines? You might have some idea of how in the hell to fix this hunk of junk.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.dst: Эх, ты разбираешься в машинах? Может, поймёшь, как, чёрт возьми, починить эту рухлядь.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.src: Fantastic, {u}! We got the bone! Couldn't have done it without you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.dst: Отлично, {u}! Кость у нас! Без тебя бы не справились.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.src: You can take it back to the coalition base. Barden and I will need to pack up before we join you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.dst: Отнеси её на базу Коалиции. Нам с Barden надо собраться, потом догоним.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.src: Just knock on the black block in front of the cave we arrived in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.dst: Просто постучи в чёрный блок у пещеры, откуда мы пришли.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.src: Head back to the Coalition Base through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.dst: Вернись на базу Коалиции через туннель.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.src: Dragon bone is one of the hardest substances in all the provinces. It's extremely rare.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.dst: Драконья кость - одно из самых твёрдых веществ во всех провинциях. Крайне редкая.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.src: We're going to present this to the Dogun chief as tribute. We need to tidy it up.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.dst: Мы преподнесём её вождю Dogun как дар. Её надо почистить.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.src: Could you get [{~} Repair Kit] from the eastern part of the base?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.dst: Можешь принести [{~} Repair Kit] из восточной части базы?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.src: Retrieve the [Repair Kit] in the eastern part of the base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.dst: Забери [Repair Kit] в восточной части базы.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.src: There are voices behind this wall, and the trail ends here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.dst: За этой стеной голоса, и след обрывается здесь.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#115.src: We have no vaults here. Must be traitors... The King really wants to see Axelus.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#115.dst: Хранилищ тут у нас нет. Значит, предатели… Король очень хочет видеть Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.src: Stand back! I'll ready the charges...

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.src: No, no, ignore the repair kit! There's no time to worry about that!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.dst: Нет-нет, забудь про ремкомплект! Не до него сейчас!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.src: Our position has been compromised, they blew our doors wide open! We have to evacuate immediately.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.dst: Нас раскрыли, они вынесли двери! Нужно немедленно уходить.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.src: We've never been caught like this before, they never knew we really had Doguns on our side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.dst: Нас никогда так не ловили, они не знали, что на нашей стороне правда есть Dogun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.src: We need to get to safety right now! The least explored area is the Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.dst: Скорее в укрытие! Меньше всего изведаны Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.src: Everyone, out! Now! They won't follow through the rough terrain!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.dst: Все наружу! Живо! По бездорожью они не погонятся!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#123.src: Find your way up to the Dogun Village through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#123.dst: Поднимись через туннель к деревне Dogun.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.src: We'll stay around here, we aren't welcome in the village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.dst: Мы останемся здесь, в деревне нам не рады.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#125.src: But... bring them... the dragon bone as a gift... If they accept it... they might accept us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#125.dst: Но… отнеси им… драконью кость в дар… Если примут её… может, примут и нас.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#125.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.src: You are free to enter the village but we will stay back and wait until the coast is clear. Keep going.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.dst: Можешь войти в деревню, а мы подождём тут, пока всё не утихнет. Иди дальше.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.src: What is...that on the...cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.dst: Что это… там на… утёсе к югу?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.src: What is... that on the... cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.dst: Что это… там на… утёсе к югу?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.src: Hey, aren't those...Doguns?! A whole settlement...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.dst: Эй, это же… Dogun?! Целое поселение…
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.src: They've been gathering forces! We must inform {p} immediately!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.dst: Они собирают силы! Надо срочно сообщить в {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.src: Human. Come talk to me... Now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.src: Human... That Dwarf, he saw us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.dst: Человек… Тот дворф, он нас видел…
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.src: They will... destroy us... If he reports... back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.dst: Они… уничтожат нас… Если он доложит… в {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.src: We need to...prepare our defenses. We need all the...help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.dst: Нужно… готовить оборону. Нам нужна любая… помощь.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.src: If you want a ticket you'll have to pay me [{~} Emerald Block].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.dst: Хочешь билет - плати мне [{~} блок изумрудов].

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#137.src: ...oh Lord, this must be why! D-Doguns?!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.src: Several rumours are suggested to be propagated amongst the population.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.dst: Предлагается распустить среди населения несколько слухов.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.src: He is consorting with the enemy! Axelus, they've tainted your soul!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.dst: Он якшается с врагом! Axelus, они осквернили твою душу!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.src: They will...destroy us... If he reports...back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.dst: Они… уничтожат нас… Если он доложит… в {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.src: "Any war could result in rioting in {p} and other established colonies."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.dst: «Любая война может вызвать бунты в {p} и других колониях.»

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.src: We need to... prepare our defenses. We need all the... help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.dst: Нужно… готовить оборону. Нам нужна любая… помощь.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.src: Wait... What are... you holding? Dragon bone...? Just what we need...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.dst: Постой… Что это… у тебя? Драконья кость…? То, что нужно…
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.src: Human... if you promise to help us... I will grant you access to... our secret elevators... You can get up and... down the heights with those.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.dst: Человек… если обещаешь помочь нам… я открою тебе… наши тайные подъёмники… На них можно… подниматься и спускаться по высотам.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.src: Please return to... us when you reach level {~}. Take this... badge so the... others recognize you... as an ally. One of the elevators is... to the south.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.dst: Вернись к… нам на уровне {~}. Возьми этот… знак, чтобы… другие признали в тебе… союзника. Один из подъёмников… на юге.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.speaker: Plario
